$comment: The places this site publishes. Editing this file is the whole editorial surface: the next run adds what appeared here and prunes what left. A group is drawn as one places_comparison and holds at most four places, which is both the chart's own limit and the point where four lines stop being readable.

site.title: Lomsdal-Visten Almanac
site.tagline: Point forecasts from three models, redrawn through the day.

places.name: Trondheim
places.note: City on the Trondheimsfjord, on the way in

places.name: Mosjøen
places.note: Town at the head of the Vefsnfjord, nearest the northern start

places.name: Tverrådalen

places.name: Fjellskardet
places.note: Pass west of Tverrådalen; open ground, 504.7 m per Kartverket dtm1

places.name: Burrienvaerie

places.name: Visttindan

places.name: Nedre Breivatnet
places.note: Optional lower-lake point for the descent and river section

groups.name: Entrance
groups.note: The two towns on the way in. Far apart and far from the route, so this map is drawn at a much smaller scale than the others.

groups.name: Northern section
groups.note: Northern start, the pass west of it, mountain proxy and quay, in the stated route sequence.

groups.name: Central section
groups.note: Three high-terrain proxies followed by the Lomsdalen valley point. Stigfjellet sits here rather than north of it because a group holds at most four.

groups.name: Southern section
groups.note: Lower and higher Breivatnet points followed by the southern endpoint.
